title: Monotonicity of the threshold log ratio
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone and nonconstant. Let $p_c\in(0,1)$ satisfy that the biased minus probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_c$ equals $1/2$. Then the function $p\mapsto\log Q_f(p)-\tfrac12\log p$, where $Q_f$ is that biased minus probability polynomial, is monotone on $(0,p_c]$.
hypotheses_covered: The biased minus probability polynomial of $f$ at $p_c$ equals $1/2$
